premises.text: Material-intensive lithium-era chemistries cannot support a large shift from fossil fuels
premises.evidence_span: given how material intensive our current battery tech is, we are never going to get there

premises.text: Flint's cellulose hydrogel paper Zn-Mn cells are rechargeable like lithium but with different materials
premises.evidence_span: our batteries are rechargeable, and they work very similar to lithium batteries. But what we have done is to change the materials that we use

premises.text: Compostability, flexible adaptive design, and operational cut-safety differentiate the cells
premises.evidence_span: Firstly, our batteries are fully compostable

premises.text: Cells stack to required shape/size as drop-in lithium replacements using familiar manufacturing
premises.evidence_span: stack up these paper batteries into the required shape and size, and we practically have a plug-and-play solution

premises.text: Abundant inputs yield roughly 10× lower manufacturing cost
Near-term focus is specialized packs for ESS and consumer devices while pursuing EV-capable variants
premises.evidence_span: you can start to see paper batteries in energy storage systems

value.text: Practical batteries that are simultaneously sustainable, cheap, and safe
value.evidence_span: not only is ours one of the most sustainable options, but also one of the most cost-efficient options out there

secondary_value.text: Enable greener EVs that are cheaper and safer
secondary_value.evidence_span: driving an EV that is not only cheaper, but safer and a whole lot more sustainable

notes: Team/university backing excluded per §4.2. 'Powering a greener future' aspiration treated as value framing. EV path kept inside application-focus premise rather than vision-only claim.
